intelligence.human_view: The top of the day view is right — he said so, item by item: the frequency jewel, the name, the day, the time, the eye that takes you back to the month. All great. What failed is everything underneath: boxes with text, then buttons, all disorganized — an organization system that does not look organized, and none of it useful. Even the wisdom board, which is not so bad, was wrecked by one line written underneath it. The lesson is the cut: keep what he liked, exactly as it is, and throw the rest away — do not tidy the pile, rebuild it as categories, laid out beautifully, the extraordinary version. That is the bar he set with "this is wow missed!!!" — the wow was the miss, and the rebuild is where it lands.
intelligence.simple_view: The top of your day is beautiful — the shiny 528, your name, today, the time, and the little eye that takes you back to the month! But everything underneath was just a messy pile of buttons, all jumbled up! So we keep the beautiful top, exactly as it is, and throw the messy pile away — and build it again, neat and tidy, in little groups, so it looks extraordinary!
